Vehicle Dispatches Increase Significantly in July

Passenger vehicle dispatches in India saw a year-on-year increase of 34.3% in July, reaching 4,57,810 units. Two-wheeler sales also experienced growth, rising 22.6% to 19,23,483 units compared to 15,69,120 units in July of the previous year. These figures reflect the latest data from SIAM.
